systems.system: Centro de Formalizacao de Empresas (CFE) register of formal companies

note: The page publishes registration statistics only (7,047 companies 2011-2025, gender breakdown); it does not state whether registration is online, underway, on paper, shares a number with tax or social security, or records beneficial owners.
The document only reports the Council of Ministers approving a legal regime for computerising civil registration; no system, procurement, pilot or rollout is stated.

facts.fact: The Centro de Formalização de Empresas is described as an autonomous public one-stop shop (guiché único) under the Ministry of Economy for company creation and registration formalities, with online company registration still only planned.

The Centro de Formalização de Empresas' official platform lets founders submit company-creation files online or through an agent, with validation and payment at the counter, and counts over 7,666 firms created.

note: Only counts of new registrations; no aspect holds a count.
